assessment.root_cause: The function `pylint.modify_sys_path()` unconditionally removed the first element of `sys.path` (see the line referenced in the issue: pylint/__init__.py#L99). When a caller inserts an arbitrary entry at position 0, that entry is discarded, breaking extensions that depend on it. The fix adds a guard that pops the first entry only when it is an empty string, '.' or the current working directory, preserving other user‑added paths.
